readme.summary: The README gives a solid high-level overview and lists multiple installation flavors with links to external docs, but lacks inline code examples, configuration guidance, and troubleshooting entirely.
readme.top_issue: No inline quick-start code example — all examples are offloaded to external links, leaving new users with no immediate hands-on starting point.

common_complaints: Rendering issues with Mapbox integration (buildings occluding deck.gl layers)
Visual rendering bugs with specific data types (binary data in ColumnLayer)
Need for broader tile format support (PMTiles, COG, MLT)
praise_themes: Active feature development and API expansion
Long-term project maturity with completed major initiatives (TypeScript support)
sentiment.summary: Project shows active maintenance with completed long-standing features and ongoing development, but recent bug reports lack timely responses.

red_flags: Some responses could be more patient with repeated or basic questions
A few comments are dismissive of suggestions without detailed reasoning
communication.summary: The maintainer responses provide technical depth and clarity, but they could improve in handling repeated questions and being more welcoming to new contributors.
